messages:
maya: Heads-up — Nexus Health just escalated. PO #NH-2026-77 was submitted for net-60 but finance flagged missing VAT reg ID and the card on file failed for the interim charge. Customer says they only process on PO terms and will not pay card fees. :grimacing.

maya: They reported duplicate charges from retries after hitting a 502 on our billing API yesterday; said amount is $18,450 + VAT. Customer blocked renewal if net terms not approved by EOD.

dennis: On it. Can you attach the PO and the procurement email? I need the approver name + company VAT number to push this through sales ops.

maya: Uploaded PO to the thread and pasted extract: 
```
PO: NH-2026-77
Total: 18450.00 USD
VAT ID: MISSING
Approver: Elena Morales, Procurement Director
Requested terms: Net 60 (invoice, arrears)
```

linda: Finance — we can make an exception for net-60 but need either a signed SOW or a billing contact email from procurement plus VAT reg. Also need credit check sign-off (payments-team). For the interim: we can't leave the account unpaid if charges have already hit. If there are duplicate successful charges we need to refund them immediately.

kevin: Re: duplicate charges — I see retries in the logs tied to a billing ingestion 502 window around 2026-03-15T18:12Z. Service sent 3 retries, two succeeded after duplicate UUIDs weren't deduped at the connector layer. I'm opening a follow-up in eng-releases to patch dedupe. For now we can flag charge IDs: ch_1A2b3 (succeeded), ch_4C5d6 (succeeded), looks like the second is the duplicate.

billing-bot: New ticket created: BLG-4629 — "Nexus Health: PO missing VAT, dispute on duplicate charges" (assigned: linda).

dennis: Proposed path: 1) Refund duplicate charge, 2) Issue temporary 30-day credit to keep service up while we process net-60 approval, 3) Require PO + VAT reg + procurement email for final approval. Linda — OK to do temporary credit?

linda: We can authorize a one-time temporary credit up to $20k pending legal/procurement docs, but require signed commitment. I'll need the procurement email thread or SOW. Also need GL code for revenue reversal: use 4101 for credits.

maya: I'll ask Elena for VAT ID and procurement confirmation, and confirm whether Nexus will accept a credit note + invoice on net-60. Copying Elena on email now.

dennis: If they refuse card fees, we should offer credit for fees and ensure future billing goes to AP on PO terms. Also loop in acct-approvals for pre-approved customers — we'll escalate if payment blocks go past EOD. :eyes:

kevin: Quick note: to prevent future duplicates I'm adding a transient guard in the billing worker to ignore identical (customer, amount, timestamp window) within 10s. Patch scheduled for tomorrow morning.

maya: Thanks — I'll update Nexus. If finance issues the temporary credit and refunds duplicates, we should be good to avoid churn.

linda: I'll process refund + temporary credit once we have confirmation of the PO email. Charging code: REFUND_DUPLICATE + TEMP_CREDIT.

dennis: Thx team. I'll ping sales-ops and legal if we don't have docs by 16:00 PT.

maya: Customer replied: procurement sent VAT reg (VAT-ES-88766) and confirmed approver Elena M. They accept temporary credit while documents are queued. Forwarding the email to finance. :thumbsup:
